summary: RMG ML Sports Holdings, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its $200M initial public offering of 20M units at $10.00/unit on June 11, 2026. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share ($0.0001 par) and one right to receive one-eighth of a Class A share upon an initial business combination. The IPO was underwritten by Santander US Capital Markets LLC under a June 9 underwriting agreement. The filing also includes a rights agreement and letter agreement with the sponsor. This is a standard SPAC IPO event executed to raise trust capital for a future de-SPAC merger. Investors should monitor the sponsor's progress in identifying and announcing a target business combination within the typical 18-24 month window.
